"Hail, traveler! Might I escort you through to Highpass? The path ahead is filled with giants and many other hungry beasts. I assure you, you will be safe with me. I must admit, I am quite experienced in the ways of the warrior. Do you [wish an escort] or will you [travel alone]?
folds under its own weight as its life blood abandons it.
squeals and lies still.
charges into the clearing with a roar.
shrieks as you crack its hard carapace, causing death.
becomes lifeless and sinks into the sludge.
fixes its eye on you as the runes on its armor crackle with energy.
rears back in a final defiant howl before giving in to the call of death.
crumbles into pieces under the final shattering blow.
I will burn my elemental prowess into you! Are you ready?!
fizzles his final spell as he drops lifelessly to the ground.
casts his evil eyes toward the encroaching menace, then dashes ahead!
The Diabolic Destroyer has been defeated! Though the legion may send a replacement, you have finished what you sought out to do and delayed their progress for a time! Congratulations!
gives into death as it falls to the ground.
gags on her own blood as she topples to the rocky soil.

The Spirit of Tunik Tamuik has been defeated! You have sent his remaining spectral essence to rest. A feeling lingers that he may once again return to defend this sanctuary from evil doers and to continue to test the priests of the trusik people.
grunts and snorts as it prepares to smash and crush enemies.
screeches eerily before heading in your direction.
bolts towards you with lightning speed!
How I loath to soil my blade with such filth.
Welcome to my humble establishment!  I specialize in cloth, but lately I have begun to dabble in silk, the finest material I have ever used.
Greetings, and welcome to my shop. I am humble merchant Shenro Kazpur of the Silent Fist Clan.
The single death of a member of the Paladins of Tunare shall plague your wretched life.
You can extinguish the flame of my existence, but you are nothing compared to the might of Fennin Ro!
There is a brief reprieve as the elemental behemoth ceases its onslaught.  It teeters, then comes crashing down.  The force of impact is tremendous, shaking what you imagine to be the entire plane.
This is no victory for you, only a delay of your inevitable demise
You have made your last mistake.

Squeeeeeeee!  Squeeee. . .

The good people of this city will know of this. They will strike back at you!
Let this pathetic fool's death be an example of Trushar's will and power.  May the waves of the sea crush your life and wash the world clean of your existence.
grasps at his throat as he chokes out a few final words, 'I foresaw this.  My death.  Our deaths.  We are all going to perish!

corpse falls to the ground with a sickening thud. 'Thank you for freeing me

By Lxanvom's might, you shall perish this day and be reborn as a death incarnate!
This is the end, but it is not over! You will not find solace in my death! Ha ha ha!
smacks the flat of his blade against the palm of his hand and says, 'You want a taste of this, ?!!'
You haven't yet been subjected to the ultimate decaying death that awaits you, but you shall soon enough.
A Dragorn flunky charges forth with a singular purpose.

feels out for its opponent with waving tentacles.

You fools! I shall tear the life from your bodies for this trespass, and what you have done to my creations!
advances with an echo of its former grace.
None shall defy the will of the keeper.
's corpse shatters into a myriad of shimmering fragments.

Hail there, friend.  Have you had a chance to visit the Queen of Thorns?  I've been a couple of times.  Absolutely amazing.  The night before it left, the shore was filled with Wayfarers Brotherhood folk that signed on to man the boat.  What a night that was!  Lots of ale and dancing.  Someone named Jeffroy was utterly out of control with his ale and tripping over everyone!

The creature's two heads face each other just before it falls to the floor, shaking the very foundation of the temple. Now there is nothing that stands between you and the being in charge of this invading army.
The Queen's hurled flames explode upon impact.

Rip, rip, rip em apart! Chew da guts and smash da heart!
